hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Europe, bordering the Aegean Sea, Ionian Sea, and the Mediterranean Sea, between Albania and Turkey || mountainous with ranges extending into the sea as peninsulas or chains of islands || strategic location dominating the Aegean Sea and southern approach to Turkish Straits; a peninsular country, with an archipelago of about 2,000 islands || Resources: lignite, petroleum, iron ore, bauxite, lead, zinc, nickel, magnesite, marble, salt, hydropower potential || Exports: refined petroleum, packaged medicine, aluminum, olive oil, tobacco (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mountainous with ranges extending into the sea as peninsulas or chains of islands || Southern Europe, bordering the Aegean Sea, Ionian Sea, and the Mediterranean Sea, between Albania and Turkey

climate.excerpt: temperate; mild, wet winters; hot, dry summers || severe earthquakes volcanism: Santorini (367 m) has been deemed a Decade Volcano by the International Association of Volcanology and Chemistry of the Earth's Interior, worthy of study due to its explosive history and close proximity to human populations; Methana and Nisyros in the Aegean are also classified as historically active

economy.excerpt: high-income EU and eurozone economy; growth above euro average, supported by private consumption and EU fund investments; structural reforms strengthening public finances and enhancing resilience within banking system; declining unemployment but low labor productivity and skill shortages || Exports: refined petroleum, packaged medicine, aluminum, olive oil, tobacco (2023) || Industries: tourism, food and tobacco processing, textiles, chemicals, metal products; mining, petroleum
